profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | R&D
profile.summary: Software engineer with over a decade of experience whose recent work includes firmware, computer vision, and machine learning. Much of what I've done has tackled problems in unfamiliar domains and emerging technologies, reflected in a career spanning mobile, cloud, and embedded engineering.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently developing RF ranging algorithms, machine learning models, embedded firmware and system software for BLE Channel Sounding micro-location systems.

Designed FFT-based and subspace super-resolution algorithms for direction-of-arrival and ranging in BLE Channel Sounding and Angle-of-Arrival micro-location systems.

Developed embedded machine learning models to improve ranging and localization accuracy.

Advanced projects from proprietary pre-spec prototypes to standards-aligned implementations as specifications matured.

Built a hardware-in-the-loop system for validating embedded hardware, firmware, and localization behavior.

Developed BLE packet-sniffing software for RSSI ranging and data distribution.

Built software to detect and remove specular reflections in a 3D reconstruction pipeline.

Developed Structure-from-Motion targetless calibration software to align LiDAR data with camera perspective.

Built system visualization software for development, analysis, and product demonstrations.
positions.insights: Embedded Software, Software Architecture and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
SpinDance engineer embedded full-time with the InfiniteKey product team; led iOS and Android application, mobile library, embedded integration, testing and marketing tools development for micro-location and vehicle access systems.

Designed customer-facing APIs for mobile frameworks integrating with InfiniteKey embedded systems.

Built an OTA firmware update system delivering cloud-sourced firmware images from a mobile phone, with availability gated by customer credentials.

Partnered with embedded engineers to design and implement the embedded-to-mobile communication interface.

Created mobile applications for system testing, product demonstrations, and marketing across vehicle and lock use cases.

Rewrote a legacy customer mobile application to support InfiniteKey embedded capabilities.

Integrated a customer-provided vehicle interface module to expose door, window, lock, and ignition state to the embedded algorithm and mobile framework.

Helped design and integrate BLE algorithm changes to improve compatibility with phones exhibiting non-standard BLE behavior.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Expanded IoT platforms for a connected-home appliance client improving their cloud architecture, security, mobile integration, and customer-facing platform experiences.

Re-architected the core cloud system to support future expansion across additional IoT appliance products.

Implemented platform security improvements, including multi-factor authentication, to reduce exposure to external attacks.

Integrated Nest functionality with the core cloud platform.

Redesigned customer-facing web pages and transactional emails for the cloud platform.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, iOS Development and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led software development for GeLo's BLE beacon platform across mobile, web, cloud, and UX.

Designed a pre-iBeacon BLE beacon-to-mobile communication protocol and built the mobile integration framework used by GeLo-powered applications.

Built production cloud systems for beacon-triggered content delivery, including a customer-facing CMS and supporting APIs.

Created GeLo Spaces, a white-label mobile application generator driven by a cloud-based configuration and design system.

Developed operational and commercialization tooling, including a Stripe-powered ecommerce site, firmware flashing/customization software, and hardware QA systems for customer-bound beacons.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, iOS Development and +5 skills
